# CheckGrow

> AI-assisted organization workspace: members, tasks, sales leads, registries, and newsletters.

CheckGrow is an operating system for small teams and agencies. Every organization gets a members board with per-person tasks, a private My Life workspace for each member, a sales-lead CRM with kanban and table views, spreadsheet-style registries, and newsletter and task-reminder emails.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product landing page.
- [Sign in](/auth): Log in or create an account.
- [Organization workspace](/admin): Members board, My Life, Sales Leads, Members & Skills, Newsletter, Registry, and Settings.
- [Join an Organization](/join-kolektiv): Discover and request membership in organizations.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How CheckGrow collects, uses, and protects user data.
- [Terms of Use](/terms): Terms governing use of the platform.
